get.summary: Retrieve data for a station with max 30 day limit or 150 000 records within the timestart and timestop interval.

parameters.name: timestart
parameters.description: Default is date and time of request minus 12 hours. 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'

parameters.name: timestop
parameters.description: Default is date and time of request. 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'

parameters.name: includesensors[]
parameters.description: Sensors to include, default is all sensors

parameters.name: operator
parameters.description: Limit selection to station from a certain operator.

parameters.name: nofilter
parameters.description: Include all values when true; when false excludes value -999 (missing value), default = false

parameters.name: allsensors
parameters.description: Show sensors that were set as hidden in the database, default=false.

parameters.name: skip_gaps_until
parameters.description: End datetime in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM). Automatically shifts time window forward if no data exists within the specified 'starttime' to 'stoptime' range, while preserving original interval duration in days. Returns empty if no data available before specified date

get.summary: Return stationlist restricted according to the 'showall' parameter, in the specified format, 'output' specifies different field lists.

parameters.name: showall
parameters.description: datastreams, g for GLOSS and a for all active.

get.summary: Return list of all sensors, with last data and time stamp restricted according to the 'showall' parameter, in the specified format

parameters.name: showall
